<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Arctic Worm Chitin Shield](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3199)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 100

**Price** 1,800 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 4
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Shield** [Tower Shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=20)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This tower shield is crafted from interlocking sections of an arctic cave worm’s chitin that are rimed with constant frost. It has Hardness 13, HP 104, and BT 52.

**Activate—Misty Chill** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You [Raise the Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=2316) and an icy mist begins to flow off it. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to cold and any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes 3d6 cold damage (DC 29 basic Reflex save).

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include chitin from an arctic [cave worm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2871).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Arctic Worm Chitin Shield
